#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
通用内容提取脚本
支持从JSON和非JSON格式中提取任意指定关键词的内容并按行分割
"""

import re
import json
from html import unescape


def decode_json_string(text):
    """
    解码JSON字符串中的转义字符
    """
    if not text:
        return text

    # 解码常见的JSON转义字符
    text = text.replace('\\n', '\n')
    text = text.replace('\\r', '\r')
    text = text.replace('\\t', '\t')
    text = text.replace('\\\\', '\\')
    text = text.replace('\\"', '"')
    text = text.replace('\\/', '/')

    return text


def clean_markdown(text):
    """
    清理markdown标记和HTML标签
    """
    # 移除markdown强调（**、__、*、_、~~等），以及多余的反引号
    text = re.sub(r'(\*\*|__|\*|_|~~|`)', '', text)
    # 移除HTML标签
    text = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', text)
    # 移除多余的空格和制表符
    text = re.sub(r'[ \t]+', ' ', text)

    # 移除开头和结尾的多余引号
    text = text.strip()
    if text.startswith('"') and text.endswith('"') and len(text) > 2:
        # 检查是否是被引号包围的内容
        inner_content = text[1:-1]
        # 确保内部没有未匹配的引号，避免错误移除
        if inner_content.count('"') % 2 == 0:
            text = inner_content

    # 移除行尾的单独引号
    text = re.sub(r'"\s*$', '', text)
    text = re.sub(r'^\s*"', '', text)

    return text.strip()


def clean_input_text(text):
    """
    清理输入文本，移除不需要的内容，参考parse_factors.py的清理方式
    """
    if not text:
        return ""

    # 移除<think>...</think>标签及其内容
    cleaned_text = re.sub(r'<think>.*?</think>', '', text,
                          flags=re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)

    # 移除可能残留的think标签
    cleaned_text = re.sub(r'</?think>', '', cleaned_text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)

    # 不在这里应用markdown清理，因为会破坏JSON格式
    # 将在提取后的内容上应用清理

    return cleaned_text.strip()


def extract_from_json_format(text, keyword):
    """
    尝试从JSON格式中提取指定关键词的内容
    """
    try:
        # 直接尝试解析整个文本作为JSON
        data = json.loads(text.strip())
        content = data.get(keyword, '')

        if content:
            # 解码JSON字符串中的转义字符
            decoded_content = decode_json_string(str(content))
            return decoded_content.strip()

    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        # 如果直接解析失败，尝试查找JSON片段
        try:
            # 更复杂的JSON匹配，支持嵌套
            brace_count = 0
            start_pos = -1
            found_objects = []  # 存储所有找到的JSON对象

            for i, char in enumerate(text):
                if char == '{':
                    if start_pos == -1:
                        start_pos = i
                    brace_count += 1
                elif char == '}':
                    brace_count -= 1
                    if brace_count == 0 and start_pos != -1:
                        # 找到完整的JSON对象
                        json_str = text[start_pos:i+1]
                        if keyword in json_str:
                            try:
                                data = json.loads(json_str)
                                content = data.get(keyword, '')

                                if content:
                                    # 解码JSON字符串中的转义字符，然后存储
                                    decoded_content = decode_json_string(
                                        str(content))
                                    found_objects.append(
                                        decoded_content.strip())
                            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                                pass
                        start_pos = -1

            # 返回最后一个（通常是最完整的）JSON对象的内容
            # 优先选择非空且不是默认值的内容
            if found_objects:
                # 过滤掉可能的默认/占位符值
                filtered_objects = [obj for obj in found_objects
                                    if obj and obj not in ['', '未找到', '未找到经济学名词', '未找到经济学名词解释']]

                if filtered_objects:
                    return filtered_objects[-1]  # 返回最后一个有效对象
                else:
                    return found_objects[-1]  # 如果都是默认值，返回最后一个

        except Exception:
            pass

    return None


def extract_relaxed_json_value(text, keyword):
    """在标准JSON解析失败时，宽松匹配形如 "key": "..." 的多行字符串内容。
    允许字符串中出现未转义的换行（非严格JSON），并抓取到结束引号。
    """
    pattern = rf'"{re.escape(keyword)}"\s*:\s*"((?:[^"\\]|\\.|[\r\n])*)"'
    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.DOTALL)
    if match:
        raw_value = match.group(1)
        # 将原始换行保留，但也尝试解码其中的转义序列
        decoded = decode_json_string(raw_value)
        return decoded.strip()
    return None


def extract_by_content_markers(text, keyword):
    """
    通过内容标记提取文本
    """
    # 查找关键词:后的内容，支持中英文冒号
    marker_pattern = rf'{re.escape(keyword)}\s*[:：]\s*(.*?)(?:\n\n|\Z)'
    marker_match = re.search(marker_pattern, text, re.DOTALL)
    if marker_match:
        return marker_match.group(1).strip()

    # 如果没有找到精确匹配，尝试查找关键词后面的内容块
    # 支持关键词出现在行首的情况
    keyword_pattern = rf'(?:^|\n)\s*{re.escape(keyword)}\s*(?:[:：]?)?\s*\n?(.*?)(?:\n\n|\n(?=[A-Z][^a-z]*[:：]?)|\Z)'
    keyword_match = re.search(keyword_pattern, text, re.DOTALL | re.MULTILINE)
    if keyword_match:
        content = keyword_match.group(1).strip()
        if content:
            return content

    return None


def extract_structured_content(text, keyword):
    """
    提取结构化内容（多段落或多行）
    如果没有找到关键词标记，尝试从整体结构中提取
    """
    # 首先尝试查找关键词附近的内容
    # 查找关键词后的多行内容
    keyword_pattern = rf'(?:^|\n)\s*{re.escape(keyword)}.*?\n(.*?)(?:\n\n|\n(?=[A-Z][^a-z]*[:：])|\Z)'
    keyword_match = re.search(keyword_pattern, text, re.DOTALL | re.MULTILINE)
    if keyword_match:
        content = keyword_match.group(1).strip()
        if content:
            return content

    # 如果没有找到关键词，尝试提取主要内容块
    # 按行分割并过滤空行
    lines = [line.strip() for line in text.split('\n') if line.strip()]

    # 如果有多行内容，可能是结构化的
    if len(lines) >= 3:
        # 检查是否有类似段落的结构
        content_lines = []
        for line in lines:
            # 跳过可能的元数据行和关键词行
            skip_keywords = ['think', 'content:', keyword.lower()]
            if any(skip in line.lower() for skip in skip_keywords):
                continue
            if len(line) > 20:  # 只保留较长的行，可能是真正的内容
                content_lines.append(line)

        if len(content_lines) >= 2:
            return '\n'.join(content_lines)

    return None


def extract_content_by_keyword(text, keyword):
    """
    主要的内容提取函数
    按优先级尝试不同的提取方法
    """
    # 首先确保移除所有<think>标签内容
    text = re.sub(r'<think>.*?</think>', '', text,
                  flags=re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)
    text = re.sub(r'</?think>', '', text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    text = text.strip()

    # 方法1: JSON格式提取
    json_content = extract_from_json_format(text, keyword)
    if json_content:
        return json_content

    # 方法1.1: 宽松JSON键值对提取（处理不规范JSON中未转义的换行）
    relaxed = extract_relaxed_json_value(text, keyword)
    if relaxed:
        return relaxed

    # 方法2: 内容标记提取
    marker_content = extract_by_content_markers(text, keyword)
    if marker_content:
        return marker_content

    # 方法3: 结构化内容提取
    structured_content = extract_structured_content(text, keyword)
    if structured_content:
        return structured_content

    return None


def process_text(input_text, keyword):
    """
    完整的文本处理流程
    返回原始提取的内容，不进行分割
    """
    # 1. 清理输入文本
    cleaned_text = clean_input_text(input_text)

    # 2. 提取指定关键词的内容
    content = extract_content_by_keyword(cleaned_text, keyword)

    # 3. 对提取的内容应用markdown清理
    if content:
        content = clean_markdown(content)

    # 4. 返回清理后的内容
    return content if content else ""


def main(arg1: str) -> dict:
    """
    主函数，接受输入文本，返回提取结果
    arg1: 输入文本
    注意: 请在代码中手动设置keyword变量的值
    """
    # 用户需要手动设置这个keyword值
    keyword = "ao1_ao2_criteria"  # 请根据需要修改这个值

    result_content = process_text(arg1, keyword)
    return {
        "result": result_content
    }

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
文本分割器
基于split_string.py扩展，支持多种分割方式
"""

import re


def split_by_delimiters(text: str) -> list:
    """
    将以分号、逗号或空格分隔的字符串拆分为字符串数组
    基于原始split_string.py的功能
    """
    if not text:
        return []

    # 使用正则表达式分割，忽略连续分隔符和首尾空白
    parts = [s for s in re.split(r'[;, ]+', text.strip()) if s]
    return parts


def split_by_lines(content: str, skip_first_line: bool = False, keyword: str = "") -> list:
    """
    将内容按行分割，可选择跳过第一行

    参数:
        content: 要分割的内容
        skip_first_line: 是否跳过第一行
        keyword: 关键词，用于判断是否跳过第一行
    """
    if not content:
        return []

    # 按换行符分割，过滤空行
    lines = [line.strip() for line in content.split('\n') if line.strip()]

    # 如果需要跳过第一行且第一行包含关键词或看起来像标题
    if skip_first_line and lines:
        if keyword and keyword.lower() in lines[0].lower():
            return lines[1:] if len(lines) > 1 else []
        elif any(title in lines[0] for title in ['Question Answer Marks', 'content']):
            return lines[1:] if len(lines) > 1 else []

    return lines


def split_by_paragraphs(content: str) -> list:
    """
    将内容按段落分割（以双换行符分割）
    """
    if not content:
        return []

    # 按双换行符分割段落
    paragraphs = [p.strip() for p in content.split('\n\n') if p.strip()]
    return paragraphs


def split_by_factors(content: str) -> list:
    """
    专门用于分割AO3因子的函数
    提取Factor 1, Factor 2, ... 等有编号的因素
    """
    if not content:
        return []

    # 提取所有factors的正则表达式
    factor_pattern = re.compile(
        r'(?:^|\n)[\s\-\*#]*Factor\s*(\d+)\s*[:：]?\s*(.*?)(?=(?:^|\n)[\s\-\*#]*Factor\s*\d+|(?:^|\n)#+\s*[Cc]onclusion|$)',
        re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL | re.MULTILINE
    )

    factors = []
    for match in factor_pattern.finditer(content):
        num = match.group(1)
        rest = match.group(2).strip()

        # 若内容为空，尝试取下一行
        if not rest:
            lines = content[match.end():].lstrip().split('\n', 1)
            if lines:
                rest = lines[0].strip()

        # 处理因子内容，查找第一个换行符来分离标题和内容
        lines = rest.split('\n', 2)
        if len(lines) > 1:
            title_part = lines[0].strip()
            reasoning_part = lines[1].strip()
        else:
            title_part = rest.strip()
            reasoning_part = ''

        # 构建因子标题
        factor_title = f"Factor {num}: {title_part}"
        factor_title = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', factor_title)
        reasoning_part = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', reasoning_part)

        if reasoning_part:
            factors.append(f"{factor_title}\n{reasoning_part}")
        else:
            factors.append(factor_title)

    return factors


def split_by_logics(content: str) -> list:
    """
    专门用于分割AO2逻辑链的函数
    提取Logic 1, Logic 2, ... 等逻辑链
    """
    if not content:
        return []

    # 清理markdown标记
    content = re.sub(r'(\*\*|__|\*|_|~~|`)', '', content)

    # 兼容"#### Topic: Logic X ..."或"### Logic X ..."或"Logic X ..."等
    logic_pattern = re.compile(
        r'(?:^|\n)\s*(?:#{2,4}\s*)?(?:Topic:\s*)?(Logic\s*\d+.*?)(?:\n|\r\n)(.*?)(?=(?:^|\n)\s*(?:#{2,4}\s*)?(?:Topic:\s*)?Logic\s*\d+|^\s*#{2,3}\s*AO3|\Z)',
        re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL
    )

    logic_chains = []
    for match in logic_pattern.finditer(content):
        title = match.group(1).strip()
        body = match.group(2).strip()
        lines = [line.strip() for line in body.split('\n') if line.strip()]
        if lines:
            chain = title + '\n' + '\n'.join(lines)
        else:
            chain = title
        logic_chains.append(chain.strip())

    return logic_chains


def split_by_keywords(content: str) -> list:
    """
    专门用于分割AO1关键词的函数
    处理加粗格式、分隔符、项目符号等
    """
    if not content:
        return []

    keyword_lines = []

    # 先找加粗关键词（如**High inflation**）
    bold_keywords = re.findall(r'\*\*([^*]+)\*\*', content)
    if bold_keywords:
        keyword_lines.extend([kw.strip() for kw in bold_keywords])

    # 按分号、逗号分割
    split_pattern = r'[;,，]'
    if re.search(split_pattern, content):
        for item in re.split(split_pattern, content):
            item = item.strip()
            # 移除加粗符号
            item = re.sub(r'^\*+|\*+$', '', item)
            if item:
                keyword_lines.append(item)
    else:
        # 按行处理
        for line in content.split('\n'):
            line = line.strip()
            if not line or line.startswith('#'):
                continue
            # 移除项目符号和加粗
            clean_line = re.sub(r'^[\s*•\-]+\s*|\d+[\.\)]\s*', '', line)
            clean_line = re.sub(r'^\*+|\*+$', '', clean_line)
            # 只取冒号前内容（如"High inflation: ..."）
            clean_line = clean_line.split(
                ':')[0].strip() if ':' in clean_line else clean_line
            if clean_line:
                keyword_lines.append(clean_line)

    # 二次清洗：移除首尾标点和重复
    cleaned_keywords = []
    seen = set()
    for kw in keyword_lines:
        kw = re.sub(r'^[,.;\s]+|[,.;\s]+$', '', kw)
        if kw and kw not in seen:
            cleaned_keywords.append(kw)
            seen.add(kw)

    return cleaned_keywords


def split_by_sentences(content: str) -> list:
    """
    将内容按句子分割
    """

"""
通用内容提取脚本
支持从JSON和非JSON格式中提取任意指定关键词的内容并按行分割
"""

import re
import json
from html import unescape


def clean_markdown(text):
    """
    清理markdown标记和HTML标签
    """
    # 移除markdown强调（**、__、*、_、~~等），以及多余的反引号
    text = re.sub(r'(\*\*|__|\*|_|~~|`)', '', text)
    # 移除HTML标签
    text = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', text)
    # 移除多余的空格和制表符
    text = re.sub(r'[ \t]+', ' ', text)
    # 移除多余的转义字符
    text = text.replace('\\"', '"').replace('\\\\', '\\').replace('\\n', '\n')
    
    # 移除开头和结尾的多余引号
    text = text.strip()
    if text.startswith('"') and text.endswith('"') and len(text) > 2:
        # 检查是否是被引号包围的内容
        inner_content = text[1:-1]
        # 确保内部没有未匹配的引号，避免错误移除
        if inner_content.count('"') % 2 == 0:
            text = inner_content
    
    # 移除行尾的单独引号
    text = re.sub(r'"\s*$', '', text)
    text = re.sub(r'^\s*"', '', text)
    
    return text.strip()


def clean_input_text(text):
    """
    清理输入文本，移除不需要的内容，参考parse_factors.py的清理方式
    """
    if not text:
        return ""

    # 处理转义字符和HTML实体
    try:
        cleaned_text = unescape(text)
        # 只在确实需要时才进行unicode_escape解码
        if '\\n' in cleaned_text or '\\t' in cleaned_text:
            try:
                cleaned_text = cleaned_text.encode(
                    'utf-8').decode('unicode_escape')
            except:
                # 如果解码失败，手动处理常见的转义字符
                cleaned_text = cleaned_text.replace(
                    '\\n', '\n').replace('\\t', '\t')
    except:
        cleaned_text = text

    # 移除<think>...</think>标签及其内容
    cleaned_text = re.sub(r'<think>.*?</think>', '', cleaned_text,
                          flags=re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)

    # 移除可能残留的think标签
    cleaned_text = re.sub(r'</?think>', '', cleaned_text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)

    # 不在这里应用markdown清理，因为会破坏JSON格式
    # 将在提取后的内容上应用清理

    return cleaned_text.strip()


def extract_from_json_format(text, keyword):
    """
    尝试从JSON格式中提取指定关键词的内容
    """
    try:
        # 直接尝试解析整个文本作为JSON
        data = json.loads(text.strip())
        content = data.get(keyword, '')

        if content:
            # 处理转义的换行符
            if isinstance(content, str):
                content = content.replace('\\n', '\n').replace('\\t', '\t')
            return str(content).strip()

    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        # 如果直接解析失败，尝试查找JSON片段
        try:
            # 更复杂的JSON匹配，支持嵌套
            brace_count = 0
            start_pos = -1

            for i, char in enumerate(text):
                if char == '{':
                    if start_pos == -1:
                        start_pos = i
                    brace_count += 1
                elif char == '}':
                    brace_count -= 1
                    if brace_count == 0 and start_pos != -1:
                        # 找到完整的JSON对象
                        json_str = text[start_pos:i+1]
                        if keyword in json_str:
                            try:
                                data = json.loads(json_str)
                                content = data.get(keyword, '')

                                if content:
                                    # 处理转义的换行符
                                    if isinstance(content, str):
                                        content = content.replace(
                                            '\\n', '\n').replace('\\t', '\t')
                                    return str(content).strip()
                            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                                continue
                        start_pos = -1

        except Exception:
            pass

    return None


def extract_by_content_markers(text, keyword):
    """
    通过内容标记提取文本
    """
    # 查找关键词:后的内容，支持中英文冒号
    marker_pattern = rf'{re.escape(keyword)}\s*[:：]\s*(.*?)(?:\n\n|\Z)'
    marker_match = re.search(marker_pattern, text, re.DOTALL)
    if marker_match:
        return marker_match.group(1).strip()

    # 如果没有找到精确匹配，尝试查找关键词后面的内容块
    # 支持关键词出现在行首的情况
    keyword_pattern = rf'(?:^|\n)\s*{re.escape(keyword)}\s*(?:[:：]?)?\s*\n?(.*?)(?:\n\n|\n(?=[A-Z][^a-z]*[:：]?)|\Z)'
    keyword_match = re.search(keyword_pattern, text, re.DOTALL | re.MULTILINE)
    if keyword_match:
        content = keyword_match.group(1).strip()
        if content:
            return content

    return None


def extract_structured_content(text, keyword):
    """
    提取结构化内容（多段落或多行）
    如果没有找到关键词标记，尝试从整体结构中提取
    """
    # 首先尝试查找关键词附近的内容
    # 查找关键词后的多行内容
    keyword_pattern = rf'(?:^|\n)\s*{re.escape(keyword)}.*?\n(.*?)(?:\n\n|\n(?=[A-Z][^a-z]*[:：])|\Z)'
    keyword_match = re.search(keyword_pattern, text, re.DOTALL | re.MULTILINE)
    if keyword_match:
        content = keyword_match.group(1).strip()
        if content:
            return content

    # 如果没有找到关键词，尝试提取主要内容块
    # 按行分割并过滤空行
    lines = [line.strip() for line in text.split('\n') if line.strip()]

    # 如果有多行内容，可能是结构化的
    if len(lines) >= 3:
        # 检查是否有类似段落的结构
        content_lines = []
        for line in lines:
            # 跳过可能的元数据行和关键词行
            skip_keywords = ['think', 'content:', keyword.lower()]
            if any(skip in line.lower() for skip in skip_keywords):
                continue
            if len(line) > 20:  # 只保留较长的行，可能是真正的内容
                content_lines.append(line)

        if len(content_lines) >= 2:
            return '\n'.join(content_lines)

    return None


def extract_content_by_keyword(text, keyword):
    """
    主要的内容提取函数
    按优先级尝试不同的提取方法
    """
    # 方法1: JSON格式提取
    json_content = extract_from_json_format(text, keyword)
    if json_content:
        return json_content

    # 方法2: 内容标记提取
    marker_content = extract_by_content_markers(text, keyword)
    if marker_content:
        return marker_content

    # 方法3: 结构化内容提取
    structured_content = extract_structured_content(text, keyword)
    if structured_content:
        return structured_content

    return None


def process_text(input_text, keyword):
    """
    完整的文本处理流程
    返回原始提取的内容，不进行分割
    """
    # 1. 清理输入文本
    cleaned_text = clean_input_text(input_text)

    # 2. 提取指定关键词的内容
    content = extract_content_by_keyword(cleaned_text, keyword)

    # 3. 对提取的内容应用markdown清理
    if content:
        content = clean_markdown(content)

    # 4. 返回清理后的内容
    return content if content else ""


def main(arg1: str) -> dict:
    """
    主函数，接受输入文本，返回提取结果
    arg1: 输入文本

    result_content = process_text(arg1, keyword)
    return {
        "result": result_content
    }

文本分割器
基于split_string.py扩展，支持多种分割方式
"""

import re


def split_by_delimiters(text: str) -> list:
    """
    将以分号、逗号或空格分隔的字符串拆分为字符串数组
    基于原始split_string.py的功能

    return parts


def split_by_lines(content: str, skip_first_line: bool = False, keyword: str = "") -> list:
    """
    将内容按行分割，可选择跳过第一行

    参数:
        content: 要分割的内容
        skip_first_line: 是否跳过第一行
        keyword: 关键词，用于判断是否跳过第一行
    """
    if not content:
        return []

    # 按换行符分割，过滤空行
    lines = [line.strip() for line in content.split('\n') if line.strip()]

    # 如果需要跳过第一行且第一行包含关键词或看起来像标题
    if skip_first_line and lines:
        if keyword and keyword.lower() in lines[0].lower():
            return lines[1:] if len(lines) > 1 else []
        elif any(title in lines[0] for title in ['Question Answer Marks', 'content']):
            return lines[1:] if len(lines) > 1 else []

    return lines


def split_by_paragraphs(content: str) -> list:
    """
    将内容按段落分割（以双换行符分割）
    """
    if not content:
        return []

    # 按双换行符分割段落
    paragraphs = [p.strip() for p in content.split('\n\n') if p.strip()]
    return paragraphs


def split_by_factors(content: str) -> list:
    """
    专门用于分割AO3因子的函数
    提取Factor 1, Factor 2, ... 等有编号的因素
    """
    if not content:
        return []

    # 提取所有factors的正则表达式
    factor_pattern = re.compile(
        r'(?:^|\n)[\s\-\*#]*Factor\s*(\d+)\s*[:：]?\s*(.*?)(?=(?:^|\n)[\s\-\*#]*Factor\s*\d+|(?:^|\n)#+\s*[Cc]onclusion|$)',
        re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL | re.MULTILINE
    )

    factors = []
    for match in factor_pattern.finditer(content):
        num = match.group(1)
        rest = match.group(2).strip()

        # 若内容为空，尝试取下一行
        if not rest:
            lines = content[match.end():].lstrip().split('\n', 1)
            if lines:
                rest = lines[0].strip()

        # 处理因子内容，查找第一个换行符来分离标题和内容
        lines = rest.split('\n', 2)
        if len(lines) > 1:
            title_part = lines[0].strip()
            reasoning_part = lines[1].strip()
        else:
            title_part = rest.strip()
            reasoning_part = ''

        # 构建因子标题
        factor_title = f"Factor {num}: {title_part}"
        factor_title = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', factor_title)
        reasoning_part = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', reasoning_part)

        if reasoning_part:
            factors.append(f"{factor_title}\n{reasoning_part}")
        else:
            factors.append(factor_title)

    return factors


def split_by_logics(content: str) -> list:
    """
    专门用于分割AO2逻辑链的函数
    提取Logic 1, Logic 2, ... 等逻辑链
    """
    if not content:
        return []

    # 清理markdown标记
    content = re.sub(r'(\*\*|__|\*|_|~~|`)', '', content)

    # 兼容"#### Topic: Logic X ..."或"### Logic X ..."或"Logic X ..."等
    logic_pattern = re.compile(
        r'(?:^|\n)\s*(?:#{2,4}\s*)?(?:Topic:\s*)?(Logic\s*\d+.*?)(?:\n|\r\n)(.*?)(?=(?:^|\n)\s*(?:#{2,4}\s*)?(?:Topic:\s*)?Logic\s*\d+|^\s*#{2,3}\s*AO3|\Z)',
        re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL
    )

    logic_chains = []
    for match in logic_pattern.finditer(content):
        title = match.group(1).strip()
        body = match.group(2).strip()
        lines = [line.strip() for line in body.split('\n') if line.strip()]
        if lines:
            chain = title + '\n' + '\n'.join(lines)
        else:
            chain = title
        logic_chains.append(chain.strip())

    return logic_chains


def split_by_keywords(content: str) -> list:
    """
    专门用于分割AO1关键词的函数
    处理加粗格式、分隔符、项目符号等
    """
    if not content:
        return []

    keyword_lines = []

    # 先找加粗关键词（如**High inflation**）
    bold_keywords = re.findall(r'\*\*([^*]+)\*\*', content)
    if bold_keywords:
        keyword_lines.extend([kw.strip() for kw in bold_keywords])

    # 按分号、逗号分割
    split_pattern = r'[;,，]'
    if re.search(split_pattern, content):
        for item in re.split(split_pattern, content):
            item = item.strip()
            # 移除加粗符号
            item = re.sub(r'^\*+|\*+$', '', item)
            if item:
                keyword_lines.append(item)
    else:
        # 按行处理
        for line in content.split('\n'):
            line = line.strip()
            if not line or line.startswith('#'):
                continue
            # 移除项目符号和加粗
            clean_line = re.sub(r'^[\s*•\-]+\s*|\d+[\.\)]\s*', '', line)
            clean_line = re.sub(r'^\*+|\*+$', '', clean_line)
            # 只取冒号前内容（如"High inflation: ..."）
            clean_line = clean_line.split(
                ':')[0].strip() if ':' in clean_line else clean_line
            if clean_line:
                keyword_lines.append(clean_line)

    # 二次清洗：移除首尾标点和重复
    cleaned_keywords = []
    seen = set()
    for kw in keyword_lines:
        kw = re.sub(r'^[,.;\s]+|[,.;\s]+$', '', kw)
        if kw and kw not in seen:
            cleaned_keywords.append(kw)
            seen.add(kw)

    return cleaned_keywords


def split_by_sentences(content: str) -> list:
    """
    将内容按句子分割
    """
    if not content:
        return []

    # 简单的句子分割，基于句号、问号、感叹号
    sentences = re.split(r'[.!?]', content)
    sentences = [s.strip() for s in sentences if s.strip()]
    return sentences


def main(arg1: str) -> dict:
    """
    主函数，根据指定类型分割内容

    参数:
        arg1: 要分割的内容
    注意: 请在代码中手动设置split_type和其他参数的值
    """
    # 用户需要手动设置这些参数值
    # 请根据需要修改: "delimiters", "lines", "paragraphs", "sentences", "factors", "logics", "keywords"
    split_type = "lines"

    keyword = ""                      # 关键词参数 (仅对lines类型有效)

    if split_type == "delimiters":
        result = split_by_delimiters(arg1)
    elif split_type == "lines":
        result = split_by_lines(arg1, skip_first_line, keyword)
    elif split_type == "paragraphs":
        result = split_by_paragraphs(arg1)
    elif split_type == "sentences":
        result = split_by_sentences(arg1)
    elif split_type == "factors":
        result = split_by_factors(arg1)
    elif split_type == "logics":
        result = split_by_logics(arg1)
    elif split_type == "keywords":
        result = split_by_keywords(arg1)
    else:
        # 默认按行分割
        result = split_by_lines(arg1)

    return {
        "result": result,
        "num_parts": len(result)
    }

"""
文本分割器
基于split_string.py扩展，支持多种分割方式
"""

import re


def split_by_delimiters(text: str) -> list:
    """
    将以分号、逗号或空格分隔的字符串拆分为字符串数组
    基于原始split_string.py的功能
    """
    if not text:
        return []

    # 使用正则表达式分割，忽略连续分隔符和首尾空白
    parts = [s for s in re.split(r'[;, ]+', text.strip()) if s]
    return parts


def split_by_lines(content: str, skip_first_line: bool = False, keyword: str = "") -> list:
    """
    将内容按行分割，可选择跳过第一行

    参数:
        content: 要分割的内容
        skip_first_line: 是否跳过第一行
        keyword: 关键词，用于判断是否跳过第一行
    """
    if not content:
        return []

    # 按换行符分割，过滤空行
    lines = [line.strip() for line in content.split('\n') if line.strip()]

    # 如果需要跳过第一行且第一行包含关键词或看起来像标题
    if skip_first_line and lines:
        if keyword and keyword.lower() in lines[0].lower():
            return lines[1:] if len(lines) > 1 else []
        elif any(title in lines[0] for title in ['Question Answer Marks', 'content']):
            return lines[1:] if len(lines) > 1 else []

    return lines


def split_by_paragraphs(content: str) -> list:
    """
    将内容按段落分割（以双换行符分割）
    """
    if not content:
        return []

    # 按双换行符分割段落
    paragraphs = [p.strip() for p in content.split('\n\n') if p.strip()]
    return paragraphs


def split_by_factors(content: str) -> list:
    """
    专门用于分割AO3因子的函数
    提取Factor 1, Factor 2, ... 等有编号的因素
    """
    if not content:
        return []

    # 提取所有factors的正则表达式
    factor_pattern = re.compile(
        r'(?:^|\n)[\s\-\*#]*Factor\s*(\d+)\s*[:：]?\s*(.*?)(?=(?:^|\n)[\s\-\*#]*Factor\s*\d+|(?:^|\n)#+\s*[Cc]onclusion|$)',
        re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL | re.MULTILINE
    )

    factors = []
    for match in factor_pattern.finditer(content):
        num = match.group(1)
        rest = match.group(2).strip()

        # 若内容为空，尝试取下一行
        if not rest:
            lines = content[match.end():].lstrip().split('\n', 1)
            if lines:
                rest = lines[0].strip()

        # 处理因子内容，查找第一个换行符来分离标题和内容
        lines = rest.split('\n', 2)
        if len(lines) > 1:
            title_part = lines[0].strip()
            reasoning_part = lines[1].strip()
        else:
            title_part = rest.strip()
            reasoning_part = ''

        # 构建因子标题
        factor_title = f"Factor {num}: {title_part}"
        factor_title = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', factor_title)
        reasoning_part = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', reasoning_part)

        if reasoning_part:
            factors.append(f"{factor_title}\n{reasoning_part}")
        else:
            factors.append(factor_title)

    return factors


def split_by_logics(content: str) -> list:
    """
    专门用于分割AO2逻辑链的函数
    提取Logic 1, Logic 2, ... 等逻辑链
    """
    if not content:
        return []

    # 清理markdown标记
    content = re.sub(r'(\*\*|__|\*|_|~~|`)', '', content)

    # 兼容"#### Topic: Logic X ..."或"### Logic X ..."或"Logic X ..."等
    logic_pattern = re.compile(
        r'(?:^|\n)\s*(?:#{2,4}\s*)?(?:Topic:\s*)?(Logic\s*\d+.*?)(?:\n|\r\n)(.*?)(?=(?:^|\n)\s*(?:#{2,4}\s*)?(?:Topic:\s*)?Logic\s*\d+|^\s*#{2,3}\s*AO3|\Z)',
        re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL
    )

    logic_chains = []
    for match in logic_pattern.finditer(content):
        title = match.group(1).strip()
        body = match.group(2).strip()
        lines = [line.strip() for line in body.split('\n') if line.strip()]
        if lines:
            chain = title + '\n' + '\n'.join(lines)
        else:
            chain = title
        logic_chains.append(chain.strip())

    return logic_chains


def split_by_keywords(content: str) -> list:
    """
    专门用于分割AO1关键词的函数
    处理加粗格式、分隔符、项目符号等
    """
    if not content:
        return []

    keyword_lines = []

    # 先找加粗关键词（如**High inflation**）
    bold_keywords = re.findall(r'\*\*([^*]+)\*\*', content)
    if bold_keywords:
        keyword_lines.extend([kw.strip() for kw in bold_keywords])

    # 按分号、逗号分割
    split_pattern = r'[;,，]'
    if re.search(split_pattern, content):
        for item in re.split(split_pattern, content):
            item = item.strip()
            # 移除加粗符号
            item = re.sub(r'^\*+|\*+$', '', item)
            if item:
                keyword_lines.append(item)
    else:
        # 按行处理
        for line in content.split('\n'):
            line = line.strip()
            if not line or line.startswith('#'):
                continue
            # 移除项目符号和加粗
            clean_line = re.sub(r'^[\s*•\-]+\s*|\d+[\.\)]\s*', '', line)
            clean_line = re.sub(r'^\*+|\*+$', '', clean_line)
            # 只取冒号前内容（如"High inflation: ..."）
            clean_line = clean_line.split(
                ':')[0].strip() if ':' in clean_line else clean_line
            if clean_line:
                keyword_lines.append(clean_line)

    # 二次清洗：移除首尾标点和重复
    cleaned_keywords = []
    seen = set()
    for kw in keyword_lines:
        kw = re.sub(r'^[,.;\s]+|[,.;\s]+$', '', kw)
        if kw and kw not in seen:
            cleaned_keywords.append(kw)
            seen.add(kw)

    return cleaned_keywords


def split_by_sentences(content: str) -> list:
    """
    将内容按句子分割
    """
    if not content:
        return []

    # 简单的句子分割，基于句号、问号、感叹号
    sentences = re.split(r'[.!?]', content)
    sentences = [s.strip() for s in sentences if s.strip()]
    return sentences


def main(arg1: str) -> dict:
    """
    主函数，根据指定类型分割内容

    参数:
        arg1: 要分割的内容
    注意: 请在代码中手动设置split_type和其他参数的值
    """
    # 用户需要手动设置这些参数值
    # 请根据需要修改: "delimiters", "lines", "paragraphs", "sentences", "factors", "logics", "keywords"
    split_type = "lines"
    skip_first_line = False           # 是否跳过第一行 (仅对lines类型有效)
    keyword = ""                      # 关键词参数 (仅对lines类型有效)

    if split_type == "delimiters":
        result = split_by_delimiters(arg1)
    elif split_type == "lines":
        result = split_by_lines(arg1, skip_first_line, keyword)
    elif split_type == "paragraphs":
        result = split_by_paragraphs(arg1)
    elif split_type == "sentences":
        result = split_by_sentences(arg1)
    elif split_type == "factors":
        result = split_by_factors(arg1)
    elif split_type == "logics":
        result = split_by_logics(arg1)
    elif split_type == "keywords":
        result = split_by_keywords(arg1)
    else:
        # 默认按行分割
        result = split_by_lines(arg1)

    return {
        "result": result,
        "num_parts": len(result)
    }

    # 移除HTML标签

    # 移除多余的空格和制表符
    text = re.sub(r'[ \t]+', ' ', text)

        # 确保内部没有未匹配的引号，避免错误移除

    提取Factor 1, Factor 2, ... 等有编号的因素
    """
    if not content:

    # 提取所有factors的正则表达式
    factor_pattern = re.compile(

    logic_pattern = re.compile(

def split_by_factors(content: str) -> list:
    """
    专门用于分割AO3因子的函数
    提取Factor 1, Factor 2, ... 等有编号的因素
    """
    if not content:
        return []

    # 提取所有factors的正则表达式
    factor_pattern = re.compile(
        r'(?:^|\n)[\s\-\*#]*Factor\s*(\d+)\s*[:：]?\s*(.*?)(?=(?:^|\n)[\s\-\*#]*Factor\s*\d+|(?:^|\n)#+\s*[Cc]onclusion|$)',

        if not rest:
            lines = content[match.end():].lstrip().split('\n', 1)
            if lines:
                rest = lines[0].strip()

        lines = rest.split('\n', 2)
        if len(lines) > 1:
            title_part = lines[0].strip()
            reasoning_part = lines[1].strip()
        else:
            title_part = rest.strip()
            reasoning_part = ''

        # 构建因子标题
        factor_title = f"Factor {num}: {title_part}"
        factor_title = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', factor_title)
        reasoning_part = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', reasoning_part)

        if reasoning_part:
            factors.append(f"{factor_title}\n{reasoning_part}")
        else:
            factors.append(factor_title)

    return factors


def split_by_logics(content: str) -> list:
    """
    专门用于分割AO2逻辑链的函数

    if not content:

    logic_pattern = re.compile(
        r'(?:^|\n)\s*(?:#{2,4}\s*)?(?:Topic:\s*)?(Logic\s*\d+.*?)(?:\n|\r\n)(.*?)(?=(?:^|\n)\s*(?:#{2,4}\s*)?(?:Topic:\s*)?Logic\s*\d+|^\s*#{2,3}\s*AO3|\Z)',
        re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL
    )

    logic_chains = []
    for match in logic_pattern.finditer(content):
        title = match.group(1).strip()
        body = match.group(2).strip()
        lines = [line.strip() for line in body.split('\n') if line.strip()]
        if lines:
            chain = title + '\n' + '\n'.join(lines)

    """
    if not content:
        return []

    keyword_lines = []

    # 先找加粗关键词（如**High inflation**）
    bold_keywords = re.findall(r'\*\*([^*]+)\*\*', content)
    if bold_keywords:
        keyword_lines.extend([kw.strip() for kw in bold_keywords])

    # 按分号、逗号分割
    split_pattern = r'[;,，]'
    if re.search(split_pattern, content):
        for item in re.split(split_pattern, content):
            item = item.strip()
            # 移除加粗符号
            item = re.sub(r'^\*+|\*+$', '', item)
            if item:
                keyword_lines.append(item)
    else:
        # 按行处理
        for line in content.split('\n'):
            line = line.strip()
            if not line or line.startswith('#'):
                continue
            # 移除项目符号和加粗
            clean_line = re.sub(r'^[\s*•\-]+\s*|\d+[\.\)]\s*', '', line)
            clean_line = re.sub(r'^\*+|\*+$', '', clean_line)
            # 只取冒号前内容（如"High inflation: ..."）
            clean_line = clean_line.split(
                ':')[0].strip() if ':' in clean_line else clean_line
            if clean_line:
                keyword_lines.append(clean_line)

    seen = set()

        kw = re.sub(r'^[,.;\s]+|[,.;\s]+$', '', kw)

            seen.add(kw)

    return cleaned_keywords

    """
    将内容按句子分割
    """
    if not content:

    # 简单的句子分割，基于句号、问号、感叹号
    sentences = re.split(r'[.!?]', content)
    sentences = [s.strip() for s in sentences if s.strip()]

    主函数，根据指定类型分割内容

    elif split_type == "keywords":

    else:
